name: Centro Historico
description: Braga's historic centre, centred on the Se cathedral and pedestrian streets like Rua do Souto. Baroque churches, plazas, cafes and shops fill the walkable old town, and Arcada and Praca da Republica anchor the city's social life.
bestFor: Travellers wanting atmosphere, cafes and sights at the doorstep

name: Sao Vitor
description: A large residential parish just east of the historic core, home to the hospital and many apartment blocks. It offers a practical mix of everyday shops, supermarkets and cafes at lower prices than the centre, while staying within easy walking distance.
bestFor: Longer-stay nomads wanting value close to the centre

name: University and Gualtar
tagline: Student district near the Minho campus
description: The northeastern area around the University of Minho's Gualtar campus. Young and student-driven, it has affordable shared housing, budget eateries and a relaxed atmosphere. Good bus links connect it to the centre, and green spaces make it pleasant.
bestFor: Budget and younger nomads wanting affordable, social housing

name: Bom Jesus and Nogueira
description: The eastern edge climbing toward the Bom Jesus do Monte sanctuary, a UNESCO-listed hillside of forest and gardens. Quieter and leafier, it suits those wanting nature and views, with the historic funicular and stairways a short trip away.
bestFor: Nature-focused stayers wanting quiet, greenery and views
